feed.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Do the accessible bathrooms at Turkey Hill get funded, and from where?

entry.title: Now following: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms
entry.summary: Do the accessible bathrooms at Turkey Hill get funded, and from where?

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: School Committee, 2026-07-29
entry.summary: Urges the school committee to prioritize Turkey Hill Elementary's ADA/handicap-accessibility needs and file the MSBA statement of interest before the January 2027 window, given the newly approved town master plan ranks Turkey Hill the town's #1 priority.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: Finance Committee, 2026-07-23
entry.summary: ADA compliance trigger tied to building investment at Turkey Hill. A formula based on assessed value means spending above a fraction of that value on the building could trigger a mandate for full ADA compliance; figures given were approximate.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: Planning Board, 2026-06-22
entry.summary: Committee reports: municipal building design committee update, extended discussion of Turkey Hill School's condition, ADA compliance costs, and MSBA funding constraints

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: School Committee, 2026-04-01
entry.summary: Facilities and grounds report: energy efficiency program, generator relocation, solar array repairs, landscaping bid, staffing changes, Turkey Hill bathrooms

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: School Committee, 2026-03-04
entry.summary: Facilities update: capital projects completed, BMS server move, Turkey Hill ADA bathrooms, roof leaks, staffing

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: Select Board, 2026-02-10
entry.summary: Repurposed van earmark for Turkey Hill ADA bathrooms. The school committee authorized the superintendent to explore repurposing a prior earmark meant for vans toward ADA bathroom upgrades at Turkey Hill.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: School Committee, 2026-02-04
entry.summary: Motion to give the superintendent permission to discuss redirecting the $195,000 earmark (passenger vans) toward Turkey Hill ADA bathrooms with Rep. Scarsdale and Sen. Cronin — passed with one abstention

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: School Committee, 2026-01-07
entry.summary: Facilities director asked to pull bathroom-accessibility cost figures out of the prior Turkey Hill engineering study to produce a standalone bathroom remodel project proposal.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: Master Plan Steering Committee, 2025-12-10
entry.summary: Consolidate the Turkey Hill renovation and school-accessibility recommendations into one line about evaluating renovations to meet accessibility standards, removing the duplicate.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: Master Plan Steering Committee, 2025-12-04
entry.summary: The group agreed that upgrading school facility accessibility (discussed in reference to Turkey Hill) belongs in the very important/very critical category of recommendations.

entry.title: Turkey Hill: the ADA bathrooms: School Committee, 2025-12-03
entry.summary: Staff will try to compile a list of lower-cost Turkey Hill accessibility upgrades, likely by January, to scope near-term spending options.
